title: Sitamgaro ne giraya mazar zehra ka
body:
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (2)
Lahad Mai hoogaya Dil beqarar zehra ka
Zamana hogaya phir soog waar zehra ka
1) Gham Mai batool Mai phir kaayenat
Doob gaie
Falak udaas huwa ruk gaie zami tadpi : 2
Ek zarra huwa gham guzaar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (2)
2) Lahad rasool ki tadpi laaraz outha kaaba
Udasi chagaie kaap uthti marqade  moula  (2)
Aaado ne cheen liya jab qarar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (2)
3) Aado ne dhaya sitam jab talak Rahi zindaan
giraya phelu aye aqadaq pa jal ta darwaza (2)
Laahad Mai kardiya Dil taar taar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (2)
4) Wo roo na subbatalaie ya masaabun kehkaar
Roolaye ke khoon hammai deraha Hai iski qabaar (2)
Haazaar gham ne  Kiya Tha hisaar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (2)
5) Hassan tadp ne laagey phir seekhoon rooaye Hussain
Lahad Mai zainabo kulsum hogaye baichaan (2)
Zamii pa toota ke bikhra Mazar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka
6) Maazare fatema zahid Jo toote kar bikhra
Tadpke rehgaiee ghazi zameene karbobala
Khuda ka Ghar bhi huwa soog waar zehra ka
Sitamgaroo ne giraya Mazar zehra ka (4)
